steps.action: Verify this is not a known monitoring tool or pen-test. Check asset register and change management calendar.
Block the scanning IP at the WAF / load balancer. Apply rate-limiting to the application endpoint.
Review 404 paths probed — were any valid paths discovered (200s or 302s mixed in)? This indicates partial success.
Check server error logs for any subsequent exploitation attempts (SQLi, XSS, SSRF) from the same IP.
Ensure no sensitive paths are reachable unauthenticated. Enable bot-detection on the web application firewall.
Log probed paths and the scanning IP as IOCs. Update WAF block list.
